verdicts.reason: A keeps the headline on one strong line and reads left to right, but the legal text next to the CTA is tiny enough to be unreadable and wraps onto a second line. There is also a large gap between the headline and the button, and the can is crammed against the left edge so it overlaps the logo circle. B repeats every one of those flaws, and it also breaks the headline into two lines, leaving 'fizz' alone on the second. That oversized headline nearly touches the top edge and sits jammed against the CTA, so the right side looks cramped and top-heavy.
